Coal.note: Central value uses hard coal; low and high span the hard coal and lignite confidence intervals because Ember reports them together.

Other fossil.note: Central value uses heavy fuel oil; low and high span heavy fuel oil and gas oil.

Bioenergy.note: Not counted: no sourced efficiency for biomass power plants. Results are lower than reality where bioenergy is a large share.
